ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in accessories for my existing devices than a dedicated smart display.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K, brilliant 4K streaming quality, TV and smart home controls, free and live TV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my Samsung TV, although its 720p screen would not benefit from 4K.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: OontZ Ultra SUP Paddleboard Bluetooth Speaker, Waterproof Bluetooth Speaker with Aux Input, 14 Watts, Crystal Clear Stereo Sound, Rich Bass, Portable Wireless Speaker up to 20 hrs Playtime (SUP-Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a need for a waterproof outdoor speaker.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Klipsch R-12SW Powerful Deep Bass Front Firing 12" Copper-Spun Driver 400W Digital Power Subwoofer 14" X 18.5" X 16"; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently building an audio system that needs a large subwoofer.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Certified Refurbished Fire TV Stick 4K with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming fits my TV use, but I would choose only one streaming stick this time.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Cube, Hands-free streaming device with Alexa, 4K Ultra HD, includes Alexa Voice Remote; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The streaming stick already covers what interests me; hands-free controls do not motivate another device.
